title: Te Mana o te Hau me te Ahi
intro: Whakaarohia he rangatiratanga e whakautu ana te hau ki tētahi rangatira kotahi, e kawe ana ngā reo o ngā mea iti rawa i te taumaha, ā, e pupuri ana ngā mana kāore e kitea e ngā kanohi noa i roto i te mahi atawhai. I riro mai i tēnei tangata tētahi rangatiratanga whakamiharo mai i tētahi o ōna mua e arohaina ana, e mau ana te mana ki runga i ngā āhuatanga o te rangi me ngā jinn. Engari i tae mai te mana nui me ngā whakamātautau nui - ā, i te wā whakamutunga ka whakakitea he mea whakamiharo mō te āhua o te ora me te mate tonu.
clues: I riro mai i ahau tētahi rangatiratanga nui i tētahi mātua arohaina, he poropiti, he pononga hoki nā Allah.
I homai e Atua ki ahau te mana whakahaere i te hau, i tukuna mai ki ahau mō ngā mahi o te marama e haere ana i te ata kotahi.
Ahakoa ngā mea hanga iti rawa ka kōrero mō taku whakatata atu, ā, ka tū ahau ki te miharo ki tō rātou mōhio.
I whakahaua e au tētahi ope nui o ngā jinn, o ngā tāngata, me ngā manu, i whakaritea katoatia ki ō rātou tūnga i mua i ahau.
I haere mai tētahi rangatira i tawhiti ki te whakamātautau i ahau ki tētahi wero uaua, ā, i kawea mai e ahau taua torona ki tōku marae i mua i te tūnga ake o te manuhiri i tōna nohoanga.
I tū tonu ahau, me te whakawhirinaki ki tētahi tokotoko, ā, ka ngaua rawatia e tētahi mea nohinohi o te whenua — kātahi anō ka mōhio te hunga i tōku taha kua hipa ahau.

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te kawe mai i te torona o te kuīni tawhiti mā roto i ngā tikanga tipua
Te tukunga ki roto i te poka hohonu i a ia e tamariki ana
Te tū atu ki ngā tohunga makutu a te kaitukino me ngā tohu whakamiharo
Te kōrero mai i te kōhungahunga hei tiaki i te honore o te whaea
Te whiwhinga i te karaipiture whakamutunga i whakakitea i runga i te maunga tapu
trial.answer: Te kawe mai i te torona o te kuīni tawhiti mā roto i ngā tikanga tipua

arabic: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةًۭ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing. (21:81)
